Secure MCP Gateway - Cache & Performance
attributes.description: Platform/SRE view of caching, session pooling, sandbox runtime, and per-request latency breakdown. Local cache hits/misses + hit ratio, Redis op rate + connection state, session pool stats (active/reuse %/evictions/queue depth/worker crashes), sandbox runtime availability + wrap failures, per-phase latency (preprocess/execute/postprocess + total) from logs, MCP handshake p50/p95/p99.
